pages: Northwind Systems employee handbook. This edition replaces all earlier versions.
Working hours are 09:00 to 17:00, Monday to Friday. Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00.

Employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave each year. Unused leave may be carried over to the next year, up to a maximum of five days. Sick leave is separate and requires a medical certificate after two consecutive days.
Parental leave is 16 weeks for the primary caregiver and 6 weeks for the secondary caregiver. Compassionate leave is up to five days for the death of an immediate family member.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date. Receipts are required for any single expense above 50 USD. Meals during approved travel are reimbursed up to 40 USD per day.
Each new employee receives a home office allowance of 500 USD. Laptops must use full-disk encryption and screen locks of five minutes or less. Personal USB storage devices are not permitted.
Performance reviews are held twice per year, in June and December. Each employee has an annual training budget of 1,200 USD. Training requests above that amount require director approval.
Employees who resign must give four weeks of written notice. The company may terminate employment with pay in lieu of notice. Exit interviews are scheduled within the final week.

Setiap karyawan baru menerima tunjangan rumah sebesar 500 USD. Laptop wajib memakai enkripsi disk penuh dan kunci layar maksimal lima menit.
Klaim biaya harus dikirim dalam 30 hari sejak tanggal pembelian. Struk wajib dilampirkan untuk setiap pengeluaran di atas 50 USD.
Review kinerja diadakan dua kali setahun, pada bulan Juni dan Desember. Setiap karyawan memiliki anggaran pelatihan tahunan sebesar 1.200 USD.

Journal of Cognitive Science. Volume 12. Abstract. The study examines the relationship between sleep duration and memory consolidation in healthy adults.
Methods. We recruited 120 participants and recorded sleep with wrist actigraphy for 14 consecutive nights.
Results. The study found that sleep improves memory consolidation in healthy adults. Participants who slept more than seven hours recalled 23 percent more words.
Discussion. These findings suggest that sleep duration is associated with memory performance. The authors note that the sample was limited to adults aged 20 to 40.
References. Smith et al. 2021. Sleep and memory. Journal of Sleep Research.
Service Agreement. This agreement is between Northwind Ltd and the client.
Term and termination. Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice. The client must pay all outstanding invoices before termination.
Confidentiality. Each party must keep the other party's confidential information secret for five years after termination.
Liability. The supplier's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the previous 12 months.
Device specifications. Operating temperature range 0 to 45 C. Storage temperature range -20 to 60 C. Weight 1.2 kg. Battery life 12 hours.
Safety. Do not operate the device above 45 C. Keep the device away from water.
Warranty. The device warranty lasts 24 months. Water damage is not covered by the warranty.
Annual Report 2025. Revenue for 2025 was 12.4 million USD, up 18 percent from 2024.
Operating expenses were 8.1 million USD. Net income was 2.3 million USD.
The company employed 240 people at the end of 2025. The board recommends a dividend of 0.15 USD per share.

Remote work policy. Employees who have completed at least six months of continuous service may request a remote work arrangement for up to three days each week, provided that the arrangement is approved in advance by their direct manager and does not reduce the team's ability to cover core collaboration hours between ten and fifteen local time, and provided further that the employee maintains a secure home network and attends all scheduled performance reviews.
